title: Cover Carried by Each Level of the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
Third-party liability cover, cover for the guest's own belongings taken in the vehicle, cover for medical
costs arising from a trip incident and roadside assistance are carried at the level of the Keyturn Guest
Protection Plan the trip is covered on. The liability cover carried also has a source, which is either the
marketplace's own policy, the state minimum or the guest's own motor policy.

| Protection level | Third-party liability cover (USD) | Source of the liability cover | Cover for the guest's belongings (USD) | Medical payments cover (USD) | Roadside assistance carried | Roadside callouts included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0.00 | the guest's own motor policy | 0.00 | 0.00 | no | 0 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 50000.00 | the state minimum | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes | 1 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 250000.00 | the marketplace's own policy | 500.00 | 2500.00 | yes | 2 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 500000.00 | the marketplace's own policy | 1000.00 | 5000.00 | yes | 3 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 750000.00 | the marketplace's own policy | 2500.00 | 10000.00 | yes | 4 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 1000000.00 | the marketplace's own policy | 5000.00 | 15000.00 | yes | 6 |

## The same schedule at a coarser grain

Cover for belongings and cover for medical costs begin only at Keyturn Standard Protection; below that level
both stand at 0.00 USD. Liability cover is carried from the marketplace's own policy on the four levels from
Keyturn Standard Protection upward, from the state minimum on Keyturn Minimum Protection, and from the guest's
own motor policy on Keyturn Declined Protection, whose marketplace liability cover is 0.00 USD. Roadside
assistance is carried on every level except Keyturn Declined Protection, and the callouts included rise with
the ladder.

## Worked reading on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical trip covered on Keyturn Advantage Protection on which the guest's suitcase is stolen from
the vehicle and the guest is treated at a clinic after the incident. On that level the plan carries 1000.00 USD
of cover for the guest's own belongings and 5000.00 USD of medical payments cover, with third-party liability
cover of 500000.00 USD written from the marketplace's own policy, and three roadside callouts included for the
trip. The same hypothetical trip covered on Keyturn Minimum Protection would carry 0.00 USD for the belongings,
0.00 USD of medical payments cover, 50000.00 USD of liability cover written at the state minimum, and one
roadside callout. On Keyturn Premier Protection the figures read 2500.00 USD, 10000.00 USD, 750000.00 USD and
four callouts, and on Keyturn Business Traveler Protection 5000.00 USD, 15000.00 USD, 1000000.00 USD and six
callouts.
